331bool ub_is_op_east_asian(utf32_t ch) {
332 return false
333 || (ch >= 0x2329 && ch <= 0x2768)
334 || (ch >= 0x3008 && ch <= 0xFD3F)
335 || (ch >= 0xFE17 && ch <= 0x13258);
336}
